title: Find the percentage of atoms with single bond.
question: Find the percentage of atoms with single bond.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond_info AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
